title: First Station: Jesus is Condemned to Death
text:
Consider how Jesus, after having been scourged and crowned with thorns, was unjustly condemned by Pilate to die on the Cross.

My Jesus, it was not Pilate; no, it was my sins that condemned
Thee to die. I beg of Thee, by the merits of this sorrowful
journey, to assist my soul in its journey towards eternity.
I love Thee, my Jesus; I love Thee more than myself; I am sorry
for having offended Thee. Never let me stray from Thee again.
Grant that I may always love Thee and do Thy will. Amen.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
